note:
R85 - gen7 loader asset table for horn / chant banks: `audio/na_en_loadfile.xml` (loose, or a member of `audioboot.big` /
`data0.big` / `audio.big` / `nocache.big`) declares one `<Asset assettype="AemsSfxGoalHornBank|AemsSfxPeriodHornBank|..." path=...
descr="<id>"/>` per numbered bank. Per tree: every copy of the load file (loose / archived, size, SHA-256, wrapper), the asset types
present with their loadtype, the (type -> {descr id: path}) table, the id sets vs the numbered members actually present (loose +
archives, from r78 / r82b) and vs the anchor's `exhibitionarena` residual ids (r78 columns for the loose trees; r82b horns for
PS3 09 / 10 / 12 / 13 / X360 09). A `goalhorn` value with no asset entry = "no loader asset for this id" (static; runtime behaviour when
an id is unlisted is NOT established). Read-only.
Usage: python r85_gen7_loadfile_horn_assets.py <out.json>
